rationale: The invariant comparison is now violated and the defect is formalized, but one question remains: whether the decided index 38 corresponds to a position any node actually holds. The final leaders report decided 38 while nodes 3 and 4 hold 37 positions, so this revision records the accepted and decided indices and the entry kind at index 37 for nodes 1, 2 and 5. If those nodes hold an entry at index 37, the decision refers to a real position that node 3 and leader 4 never accepted; if they also stop at index 36, the decided index is beyond every local log. Both outcomes sharpen the defect; the seeded run, traces, promise diagnostics, entry kinds, is_reconfigured flags and both comparisons stay unchanged.

experiment.revision_reason: Adds n1_accepted/n1_decided/n1_k37, n2_accepted/n2_decided/n2_k37 and n5_accepted/n5_decided/n5_k37 to the safety event, so the receipt shows whether any of the remaining nodes holds a position at index 37. All previously recorded fields and both comparisons are unchanged.

scope.description: Same five-node lossy stress with seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c, reconfigure at action 450, 20 percent loss, node 3 trace, node 4 promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured flags, entry kinds at 35 to 37 and the p4_gap invariant, run id 13. The safety event additionally reports accepted and decided indices and the entry kind at index 37 for nodes 1, 2 and 5.
assumptions: Index 37 is the first position beyond the 37 that nodes 3 and 4 report as accepted, so its kind shows whether a 38th entry exists locally.
All samples are taken at the same end-of-run point.
No snapshots or trimming are involved.
excluded: Starting the next configuration, snapshots, flexible quorums, crash-restart and Byzantine participants.

experiment.prefix: Identical to randomized_reconfig_diagnose_lag with the node 3 trace, node 4 promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured flags, entry kinds and the p4_gap invariant. The safety event gains n1_accepted, n1_decided, n1_k37, n2_accepted, n2_decided, n2_k37, n5_accepted, n5_decided and n5_k37, computed from nodes[0], nodes[1] and nodes[4] with the existing entry_status helper over read(37).

comparisons.description: Bounded convergence past the resend timeout: all nodes report the same decided index.
Decided index never exceeds the accepted index on the final leader: node 4's decided index minus its accepted index is zero.
